This '''Small Size Droid'''<ref name="Hint Book">''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''</ref> was a small wheeled [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that at rest looked similar to the [[MSE-series]] "Mouse" droids, but could raise up and fire a jolt of energy at an enemy. These droids could be found on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="SWNES" />
